web.title_en: Windows DLL Load Anomaly Detection (Part 1)
web.description_en: Windows DLL Load Anomaly Detection (Part 1) Was the check really performed after the DLL was queued? The startup enumeration sends plugins into a verification queue. When a worker thread retrieves one, it skips it directly because 'this path is already registered.' Looking further down AntiHijackDlls.cpp, the issue lies in the usage of the same collection in two places: enumeration uses it to record seen paths, while the worker thread uses it to decide whether to check again.

web.title: Researchers Demonstrate Ghostscript Sandbox-Escape RCE via Crafted File Uploads in Popular Apps
web.description: A now-patched flaw in Ghostscript allows a crafted file to escape the program's security sandbox and run commands on the server that processes it.   Ghostscript is the interpreter that many Linux servers use to convert uploaded PDFs, PostScript files, and images into other formats, often without the application calling it directly.   Security firm pwn.ai  showed this week that ordinary upload, preview, and print features in about ten common applications could be tricked into feeding it such a file. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-125396 , was fixed on September 8, and there have been no reports of it being used in attacks.   Getting a crafted file to Ghostscript is easy, because an application does not have to call it directly.
